overview: A Sinhala-language mobile web app for a fruit and vegetable collection company, with role-based Admin and Officer access, farmer management, harvest entry, price lists, and reports.
features: Sign in as Admin or Officer with seeded credentials
View Admin and Officer login credentials on the sign-in screen
Manage farmers and record harvests with frozen prices
Maintain the product price list (Admin only)
Manage Officer accounts and reset passwords (Admin only)
View daily and grouped collection reports
